entities.summary: Randy Miguel Rosario Luperon is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Minnesota Twins, Chicago Cubs, and Kansas City Royals, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chunichi Dragons.
